instruction: Name the artist most recommended to me on Spotify.

arguments.code:
token='eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9.eyJzdWIiOiJzcG90aWZ5K2NhcmJyb3duQGdtYWlsLmNvbSIsImV4cCI6MTY4NDQxMjA5OH0.kf2xG5M8F_mduPWJbWrURnNy6or8nSA7bzIo2UbELCk'
page_limit=20
all_recs=[]
page_index=0
while True:
    recs=apis.spotify.show_recommendations(access_token=token, page_index=page_index, page_limit=page_limit)
    print('page',page_index,'count',len(recs))
    if not recs:
        break
    all_recs.extend(recs)
    page_index += 1
print('total',len(all_recs))
# count artists across all songs, including all artists listed per song
from collections import Counter
counts=Counter()
first_seen={}  # artist->first index
for i,song in enumerate(all_recs):
    for a in song.get('artists',[]) or []:
        name=a.get('name')
        if name is None:
            continue
        counts[name]+=1
        if name not in first_seen:
            first_seen[name]=i
print('counts',dict(counts))
# choose most frequent; tiebreaker by first appearance then alphabetical
max_count=max(counts.values())
candidates=[name for name,c in counts.items() if c==max_count]
# sort by first_seen then name
candidates.sort(key=lambda n:(first_seen.get(n,10**9), n))
print('max_count',max_count)
print('candidates',candidates)
print('answer',candidates[0] if candidates else None)
